title: PU-12M lesson 5: the battery commander, in command
status: A seat lesson (docs/TUTORIALS.md): step by step, each control highlighted, the next step only once it is done.
source: sam3d; the moves, their order and their waits are the console's procedures (data/procedures/pu12m.json: deploy_aspd, deploy_command_radios) and the crew data's reports (data/crew/pu12m_crew.json), with their sources; the R-407's from its instruction plate (r407_plate)
notes: The learner gives the orders himself.

steps.title: The battery commander's seat
lines: You are the battery commander, in the post: on the bench at the right.
You command the post's crew and the battery's launchers. The regiment's picture shows on your IT-45; you choose the targets and give each to a launcher on the battery net.
Each step lights up what to use; only that works. Read, then press Enter.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: The IT-45 tube
lines: In front of you: the IT-45, the air picture.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The DT-2 marker
lines: At its right, low: the DT-2's two wheels. They move a marker over the tube, in azimuth and range: put it on a target and the post knows which you mean.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The ДХ keypad
lines: At its left: the ДХ keypad. ЦУ (designation) and then a launcher's place, 1 to 5, gives that launcher the marked target.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The ФР block
lines: Right of the tube: the ФР block with the ASPD-U's power and the scale switch.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The IT-2M status board
lines: Above: the IT-2M board, each launcher's lamps: ready, on a target, launched, its missiles.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The R-407 (FuG-5)
lines: Behind you at your right, on its bracket over the BP-3: the R-407. The regiment's telecode comes in on it, duplex: its receiver on the regiment's transmitter, its own transmitter 4 MHz lower.
The plan for this exercise: receive 56.0 MHz, transmit 52.0. Its two drums show the frequency in hundreds of kHz; a СТОПОР lever holds each knob.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: Free the receiver's knob: СТОПОР
lines: Release the receiver's СТОПОР (the lever above the left knob).
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The receiver to 56.0 MHz
lines: Turn the left knob until the receiver's drum reads 56.0 MHz (560 on the drum).
steps.why: Off the regiment's channel by more than the АПЧ can pull (15 kHz), the set hears nothing.
steps.hint: Hold the left button on the knob and drag sideways, or roll the mouse wheel over it.

steps.title: Lock it
lines: Lock the receiver's СТОПОР.
steps.why: The plate: set the frequencies, then fix them with the СТОПОР handles.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: Free the transmitter's knob
lines: Release the transmitter's СТОПОР (the lever under the right knob).
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The transmitter to 52.0 MHz
lines: Turn the right knob to 52.0 MHz: 4 MHz under the receiver.
steps.why: In duplex the set's own transmitter is on the air: 4 MHz away, the receiver doesn't hear it.
steps.hint: Hold the left button on the knob and drag sideways, or roll the mouse wheel over it.

steps.title: Lock it
lines: Lock the transmitter's СТОПОР.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: Give «Пункт управления развернуть!»
lines: Order the post deployed: O, then «Пункт управления развернуть!» (Deploy the post!). Each of the crew sets to his part.
steps.why: One order sets the whole crew working: the driver's power, the radio operator's mast, the squad leader's orientation, and yours.
steps.hint: O: your orders, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: The ASPD-U on
lines: When the radio operator has the 220 V through to the equipment, switch the ASPD-U on.
steps.why: The ASPD-U takes the regiment's telecode and draws it on your tube.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The scale: М50
lines: Set the scale to М50: the tube's edge is 50 km out.
steps.hint: Left click: one position on.

steps.title: РАБОТА
lines: When the ASPD-U has warmed up, ФР to РАБОТА.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: Your R-123M on: the battery net
lines: Switch your R-123M (FuG-4) on: the battery net to the launchers.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The R-407 on: the regiment's telecode
lines: And the R-407 (FuG-5): ПИТАНИЕ on, bottom centre. The telecode from the regiment comes in on it.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click (L: turn round to it; you get up for the lower switches).

steps.title: R-407: РОД РАБОТЫ to ДУПЛЕКС
lines: РОД РАБОТЫ (upper left) to ДУПЛЕКС.
steps.hint: Right click: one position back.

steps.title: The channel to the ASPD-U: 4-ПР. ТВ
lines: The modes switch (lower right) to 4-ПР. ТВ: the channel goes out on the 4-wire terminals to the ASPD-U's telecode receiver.
steps.why: On the 2-wire positions the channel ends in the handset: the ASPD-U gets nothing.
steps.hint: Left click: one position on (three clicks).

steps.title: ПУ to КОНТРОЛЬ
lines: ПУ to КОНТРОЛЬ: you can listen on the channel the ASPD-U works.
steps.hint: Left click: one position on.

steps.title: The R-111's antenna on the mast
lines: The R-111's antenna tuner (the SAU block) is on the floor under the bench's back: get up and turn to it. When the mast is up, its antenna distributor to ТЕЛЕСКОП. The radio operator tunes the R-111 once you have.
steps.why: On the 16 m mast the regiment's net reaches 45-60 km; on the roof's whip, 35.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The RTK-1 on
lines: And the RTK-1 radiotelephone concentrator.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The regiment's picture
lines: The post is deploying round you. When the ASPD-U works and the R-407 is warm, the regiment's picture comes in on the tube.

steps.title: A target
lines: A target comes in from the north. It will show on the IT-45 when it is inside 50 km.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: The marker onto it: the DT-2's azimuth
lines: Turn the DT-2's azimuth wheel until the marker's line crosses the target. Hold the wheel: your eyes go to the tube as you turn it.
steps.why: The marker tells the post which target you mean: its azimuth first, then its range.
steps.hint: Hold the left button on the wheel and drag sideways, or roll the mouse wheel over it.
steps.wait_text: the battery net (your R-123M warmed up), and a target on the tube

steps.title: And its range
lines: Now the range wheel: bring the marker out along the line onto the target, until the tube brightens it.
steps.hint: Hold the left button on the wheel and drag sideways, or roll the mouse wheel over it.

steps.title: Designate: ЦУ
lines: The target is marked: press ЦУ on the ДХ keypad.
steps.why: ЦУ holds the marked target for a launcher's address.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: To launcher 21: 1
lines: Press 1: the first launcher, the 21. The post speaks the target's number, azimuth and range to it on the battery net; the step is done when it has gone out (if the marker has slipped off the target, put it back and press ЦУ again).
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The launcher fires
lines: The 21's crew turns its radar onto the target and engages it. Watch the IT-2M's lamps and listen for its report.

steps.title: In command: done
lines: That is the battery commander's work in the post: the post deployed by your order, your equipment on, and a target given to a launcher.
Esc, then M: the missions menu.
